title: Transfer learning identifies weak SARS-CoV-2 main protease inhibitors
summary: A transfer-learning model with data augmentation outperformed graph convolution, random forest and Chemprop baselines on an external test set and was used to screen natural and de novo compound libraries. Of 27 compounds tested, gossypol acetic acid and hyperoside inhibited Mpro with IC50 values of 67.6 uM and 235.8 uM. The hits are weak inhibitors.
ai_technology: Fine-tuned transfer-learning model with data augmentation for Mpro activity
organization: Cechanover Institute of Precision and Regenerative Medicine, School of Medicine, The Chinese University of Hong Kong (Shenzhen), Shenzhen, China; University of Science and Technology of China, Hefei, China
